name: table
title: Table
description: A plain, styled HTML table for small static data: header, body, footer, caption, numeric cells, three densities and a sticky header.
whenToUse: Small static or caller-managed tables: invoices, settings lists, open orders and positions with a row action.
notFor: Large, sortable, filterable or editable data (data-grid).
Collapsing rows into cards on a phone: the table scrolls sideways under a pinned first column instead.

states: row hover (hover tint arrives at once, leaves over --pui-motion-out)
selected (data-state="selected" on the row: accent tint, 2px accent-ink edge at the inline start, ink text)
sticky header (opaque surface, its own line seam)
pinned first column (sticky cells keep the row's hover and selected paint)
unmeasured cell (data-null: ink-3 dash, the caller adds "Not measured")
empty (the caller renders one full-width row with its message)
spec.motion: Row hover only: arrives at 0ms, leaves over --pui-motion-out. Nothing else moves; reduced motion changes nothing.

props.name: density
props.description: Row height: 32, 40 (default) or 48 px; the same three steps as every dense component.

spec.appearance: Managed appearance changes preserve mounted controls and operational state. Instance design props override scoped defaults; classNames addresses documented slots.

notes: Foundation exceptions (O1 §14.2): the selected-row edge is a 2px inset mark in --pui-accent-ink (O1 §6 selection geometry, logical per direction); the sticky header's seam is a 1px hairline in --pui-line.
